presets.label: Low
presets.description: RTX 2060-3060 / 4060, AMD and Intel with RT. No ray tracing, no Ray Reconstruction: screen-space GI and contact shadows.

presets.label: Medium
presets.description: RTX 3070/3080, 4060 Ti/4070. Opaque ray-traced geometry, RT GI, fast local-light shadows, glossy reflections.

presets.label: High
presets.description: Estimated for RTX 4080/4090 and 5080. Ray-traced lighting and full geometry; hardware suitability is not a measured frame-rate promise.

presets.label: Ultra (RTX 5090)
presets.description: RTX 5090 at 4K-class output. High plus Ray-traced High GI, hidden-roof sun shadows, rougher reflections and a 58 fps rendered cap (estimated 116 displayed with frame generation 2x). Includes water refraction and Far off-screen bounce light. Reference coverage: RTX 5090 scenes.

knobs.label: Ray Reconstruction
knobs.description: Reconstructs ray-traced lighting with DLSS Ray Reconstruction. Requires a compatible NVIDIA RTX GPU and DLSS enabled in the game.
knobs.summary: Reconstructs ray-traced lighting with DLSS Ray Reconstruction. Requires a compatible NVIDIA RTX GPU and DLSS enabled in the game.

knobs.label: Ray-traced geometry
knobs.description: Includes scene geometry in ray-traced lighting. Full also includes cutout foliage, grates and chains.
knobs.summary: Includes scene geometry in ray-traced lighting. Full also includes cutout foliage, grates and chains.

knobs.label: Sun shadows
knobs.description: Adds accurate sunlight shadows. The hidden-roof level also keeps shadows from roofs and canopies the camera hides. Roofs cost +0.3 to +1.3 ms.
knobs.summary: Adds accurate sunlight shadows. The hidden-roof level also keeps shadows from roofs and canopies the camera hides. Roofs cost +0.3 to +1.3 ms.

knobs.label: Global illumination
knobs.description: Adds indirect light and contact shading. Ray-traced High uses more samples to reduce noise.
knobs.summary: Adds indirect light and contact shading. Ray-traced High uses more samples to reduce noise.

knobs.label: Lighting trace resolution
knobs.description: Half width and height saves tracing work. May soften thin detail; full resolution in High and Ultra.
knobs.summary: Half width and height saves tracing work. May soften thin detail; full resolution in High and Ultra.

knobs.label: Local light shadows
knobs.description: Adds shadows from torches, lamps and spells. Fast requires Ray Reconstruction; Full keeps native shadows where needed.
knobs.summary: Adds shadows from torches, lamps and spells. Fast requires Ray Reconstruction; Full keeps native shadows where needed.

knobs.label: Reflections
knobs.description: Adds reflections on smooth surfaces. Higher levels include rougher surfaces; without Ray Reconstruction only mirror-like surfaces are traced.
knobs.summary: Adds reflections on smooth surfaces. Higher levels include rougher surfaces; without Ray Reconstruction only mirror-like surfaces are traced.

knobs.label: Frame generation
knobs.description: Adds generated display frames between rendered frames. Requires NVIDIA Reflex; display-frame estimates are not measured frame rates.
knobs.summary: Adds generated display frames between rendered frames. Requires NVIDIA Reflex; display-frame estimates are not measured frame rates.

knobs.label: RT lighting intensity
knobs.description: Adjusts the strength of indirect light, local shadows and reflections. Lower values blend toward the original appearance.
knobs.summary: Adjusts the strength of indirect light, local shadows and reflections. Lower values blend toward the original appearance.

knobs.label: Frame cap (rendered fps)
knobs.description: Limits rendered frames per second. Frame generation can increase displayed frames without increasing rendered frames.
knobs.summary: Limits rendered frames per second. Frame generation can increase displayed frames without increasing rendered frames.

knobs.label: NVIDIA Reflex
knobs.description: Reduces rendering latency. Frame generation requires On or On + Boost.
knobs.summary: Reduces rendering latency. Frame generation requires On or On + Boost.

knobs.label: RT water
knobs.description: Adds reflections, shadows and a refracted view of the water bed. Enabling water lighting requires a restart.
knobs.summary: Adds reflections, shadows and a refracted view of the water bed. Enabling water lighting requires a restart.

cost.provenance: RTX 5090; Water Queens House; 4K-class output; 2026-11-02 progress; ABI 26; all water levels; total water chain. Reference only.

knobs.label: Water interface Fresnel
knobs.description: Separates clean-water reflection from column opacity. Pending qualification; compare shallow pool reflections at S8 Water Queens House.
knobs.summary: Separates clean-water reflection from column opacity. Pending qualification; compare shallow pool reflections at S8 Water Queens House.

knobs.label: Opacity micromaps
knobs.description: Accelerates cutout shadows with locally prepared foliage masks on compatible hardware. About 1 ms faster at camp on RTX 5090; requires a restart.
knobs.summary: Accelerates cutout shadows with locally prepared foliage masks on compatible hardware. About 1 ms faster at camp on RTX 5090; requires a restart.

cost.provenance: RTX 5090; camp om4; 2026-11-03 08:10; RT passes 8.65-8.75 ms vs reference 9.37-10.08 ms; 1.17G rays compared, 0 not compared, 0 violations. Reference only.

knobs.label: Offline cutout masks
knobs.description: Uses foliage masks prepared locally from your game installation. Required for accelerated cutout shadows; unavailable masks keep the original path.
knobs.summary: Uses foliage masks prepared locally from your game installation. Required for accelerated cutout shadows; unavailable masks keep the original path.

cost.provenance: RTX 5090; va1 camp 2026-11-02; energy +0.24% within +/-1.95% repeat band; RT passes unchanged. Masks generated on the player's PC. Reference only.

knobs.label: Water: hidden-surface reflections
knobs.description: Shades hidden/off-screen objects reflected in water. First enable compiles for about a minute. S8 pool: compare reflected objects. Cost: +0.8-2.4 ms.
knobs.apply_note: live; needs captured materials at startup
knobs.summary: Shades hidden/off-screen objects reflected in water. First enable compiles for about a minute. S8 pool: compare reflected objects. Cost: +0.8-2.4 ms.

knobs.label: Water reflection optimizations
knobs.description: Experimental: compare sparse light lookup, zero-light rejection and candidate order. Energy qualification pending.
knobs.summary: Experimental: compare sparse light lookup, zero-light rejection and candidate order. Energy qualification pending.

knobs.label: Off-screen bounce light
knobs.description: Lights bounce from hidden surfaces, including glowing ones. Near ~+0.6 ms, Far ~+4 ms; Far + reflections ~+6 ms (experimental).
knobs.apply_note: Restart to first enable capture or turn it off; Near/Far/reflection changes may hitch while pipelines compile.
knobs.summary: Lights bounce from hidden surfaces, including glowing ones. Near ~+0.6 ms, Far ~+4 ms; Far + reflections ~+6 ms (experimental).

cost.gpu: Near ~+0.6 ms; Far ~+4 ms; reflections ~+6 ms
cost.provenance: RTX 5090; 4K-class output; Far 6 m; includes emission +0.08 ms and far-field GI trace +3.2-3.7 ms; reflection level experimental. Reference only.

knobs.label: Box light shadows
knobs.description: Shadows from projector lights in interiors, preserving the game's non-shadow-casting art lights. All in Ultra, Off in lower presets; +0.13 ms at the forge (RTX 5090).
knobs.summary: Shadows from projector lights in interiors, preserving the game's non-shadow-casting art lights. All in Ultra, Off in lower presets; +0.13 ms at the forge (RTX 5090).

cost.provenance: RTX 5090; ls_box=2, ls_box_honour_shadow=1; ba1 S6 Grymforge 2026-11-03 08:02 valid, user approved. Local-light pass 0.45 ms off -> 0.58 ms fixed; pixels > 8 levels 8.6% vs OFF/OFF 8.5%, mean signed difference 0.0; energy within noise; unshadowed traces 0 (old mode 369M/120 frames, -5.27% lit luminance).

knobs.label: RR hair dither resolve
knobs.description: Smooths hair coverage before RR. Dialogue3: thin hair against depth of field; compare dotted shimmer. Cost: unmeasured; may soften edges.
knobs.summary: Smooths hair coverage before RR. Dialogue3: thin hair against depth of field; compare dotted shimmer. Cost: unmeasured; may soften edges.

knobs.label: RR order
knobs.description: Moves RR before/after game post-processing. Dialogue3: thin hair against depth of field; compare dotted shimmer. Cost: unmeasured.
knobs.summary: Moves RR before/after game post-processing. Dialogue3: thin hair against depth of field; compare dotted shimmer. Cost: unmeasured.

knobs.label: Temporal depth of field and bloom
knobs.description: Smooths depth of field and bloom around fine edges. Experimental; quality and GPU cost await a live comparison.
knobs.summary: Smooths depth of field and bloom around fine edges. Experimental; quality and GPU cost await a live comparison.

knobs.label: Compact ray hit state
knobs.description: Reduces ray hit state and reuses immutable light metadata. Image identity and GPU cost await qualification.
knobs.summary: Reduces ray hit state and reuses immutable light metadata. Image identity and GPU cost await qualification.

knobs.label: Cache alpha metadata
knobs.description: Reuses immutable alpha metadata within a ray query. Ray footprint and native coverage remain unchanged. GPU cost awaits qualification.
knobs.summary: Reuses immutable alpha metadata within a ray query. Ray footprint and native coverage remain unchanged. GPU cost awaits qualification.

knobs.label: Skip empty water tiles
knobs.description: Skips water composition work where no pixel can use a reflection. Native scene colour is preserved. GPU cost awaits qualification.
knobs.summary: Skips water composition work where no pixel can use a reflection. Native scene colour is preserved. GPU cost awaits qualification.

knobs.label: Water camera correction
knobs.description: Keeps water reflections on while the camera turns (traces the reflection scene in its own camera space).
knobs.summary: Keeps water reflections on while the camera turns (traces the reflection scene in its own camera space).

cost.gpu: +0.00 ms (compose 0.12 ms on and off) S8
cost.provenance: RTX 5090; wf9 2026-11-03: turning screen hits 7% -> 17%, hidden 25% -> 15.5%, static delta 0 m, energy within noise

knobs.label: Native hair + scalp
knobs.description: Hair and scalp cast correct shadows and occlusion in ray tracing (needed for hair shadows on faces and necks). + Tilesets also enables tileset coverage.
knobs.summary: Hair and scalp cast correct shadows and occlusion in ray tracing (needed for hair shadows on faces and necks). + Tilesets also enables tileset coverage.

cost.gpu: RT +2.3-6.3 ms, GI +3.2-8.8 ms over cards (S8, dialogues)
cost.provenance: RTX 5090; hair_qual 2026-11-03; user decision: hair shadows need it, cost accepted

knobs.label: Omit hair from indirect rays
knobs.description: Reduces native hair work in GI bounce rays. Hair sun and local shadows remain. Indirect brightness and cost are unqualified.
knobs.summary: Reduces native hair work in GI bounce rays. Hair sun and local shadows remain. Indirect brightness and cost are unqualified.

knobs.label: Strand hair in ray-traced lighting
knobs.description: Uses strands in RT shadows/AO/GI/reflections. Dialogue1: hair shadows on faces/necks. RTX 5090 vs native cards: RT -1.1-1.5 ms, GI -1.6-1.8 ms; refit +0.57 ms.
knobs.apply_note: live; supported LSS hardware and local groom files required
knobs.summary: Uses strands in RT shadows/AO/GI/reflections. Dialogue1: hair shadows on faces/necks. RTX 5090 vs native cards: RT -1.1-1.5 ms, GI -1.6-1.8 ms; refit +0.57 ms.

knobs.label: Strand hair on screen
knobs.description: The visible hair of converted styles becomes strands (needs strand hair in RT lighting). Moving hair keeps camera motion vectors for now. Cost and look unqualified.
knobs.apply_note: live; supported LSS hardware, local groom files and shaderInt64 required
knobs.summary: The visible hair of converted styles becomes strands (needs strand hair in RT lighting). Moving hair keeps camera motion vectors for now. Cost and look unqualified.

knobs.label: Physical strand shading
knobs.description: Lights the on-screen strands with a fibre BSDF and multiple scattering instead of the game's hair shading. Brighter, warmer hair; cost and look unqualified.
knobs.apply_note: live; needs Strand hair on screen
knobs.summary: Lights the on-screen strands with a fibre BSDF and multiple scattering instead of the game's hair shading. Brighter, warmer hair; cost and look unqualified.

knobs.label: Strand hair crowd budget
knobs.description: Caps the strand groom work of a crowd: the largest characters get the finest strands, far ones coarser strands or cards. Refit and memory scale with it.
knobs.summary: Caps the strand groom work of a crowd: the largest characters get the finest strands, far ones coarser strands or cards. Refit and memory scale with it.

knobs.label: Subpixel distant hair cards
knobs.description: Keeps game cards for proven distant subpixel static hair draws. Unsupported sources keep full native hair. Energy and cost are unqualified.
knobs.summary: Keeps game cards for proven distant subpixel static hair draws. Unsupported sources keep full native hair. Energy and cost are unqualified.

knobs.label: Retire unused hair snapshots
knobs.description: Reclaims and packs unused native hair snapshots (mesh pool -26-50%, no GPU cost).
knobs.summary: Reclaims and packs unused native hair snapshots (mesh pool -26-50%, no GPU cost).

knobs.label: Single-sample hair coverage
knobs.description: Uses one secondary-ray coverage sample and early hit-AO exit. Dialogue1/Dialogue3: compare hair shadows. No measured speed gain; coverage/AO approximation unqualified.
knobs.summary: Uses one secondary-ray coverage sample and early hit-AO exit. Dialogue1/Dialogue3: compare hair shadows. No measured speed gain; coverage/AO approximation unqualified.

knobs.label: Mean hair coverage for GI
knobs.description: Uses stored empirical strand coverage probabilities for GI bounce rays. Indirect energy and cost remain unqualified.
knobs.summary: Uses stored empirical strand coverage probabilities for GI bounce rays. Indirect energy and cost remain unqualified.

knobs.label: Static roof casters only
knobs.description: Excludes animated and unclassified shadow-map copies from roof sun shadows. May omit some roofs; dialogue motion and roof coverage are unqualified.
knobs.apply_note: live; allow two frames for capture replacement
knobs.summary: Excludes animated and unclassified shadow-map copies from roof sun shadows. May omit some roofs; dialogue motion and roof coverage are unqualified.

knobs.label: Physical hair ray origins (advanced)
knobs.description: Adjusts where light rays start on hair to improve secondary lighting. Quality and cost remain unqualified.
knobs.apply_note: Enable at startup to reserve ray-origin resources; then live A/B is available.
knobs.summary: Adjusts where light rays start on hair to improve secondary lighting. Quality and cost remain unqualified.

knobs.label: Preserve cutout capture on overflow
knobs.description: Preserves more cutout surfaces when scene capture fills. Quality and cost remain unqualified.
knobs.summary: Preserves more cutout surfaces when scene capture fills. Quality and cost remain unqualified.

knobs.label: Hit material CPU batching
knobs.description: Tests recording-owned candidate lists, short query snapshots and batched material row uploads. No measured gain: G-buffer hooks 1.16 ms in both states. Keep off. Requires Hidden-surface shading at startup.
knobs.summary: Tests recording-owned candidate lists, short query snapshots and batched material row uploads. No measured gain: G-buffer hooks 1.16 ms in both states. Keep off. Requires Hidden-surface shading at startup.

knobs.label: Reuse capture hook state
knobs.description: Reuses immutable pipeline eligibility and gathers repeated instance matrices once per submit. REJECTED: submit CPU 20.2 -> 26.8 ms; matrix copies 0.31 -> 0.52 ms/build. Keep off.
knobs.summary: Reuses immutable pipeline eligibility and gathers repeated instance matrices once per submit. REJECTED: submit CPU 20.2 -> 26.8 ms; matrix copies 0.31 -> 0.52 ms/build. Keep off.

knobs.label: Batch descriptor and submit bookkeeping
knobs.description: Reuses CPU scratch and batches compatible descriptor updates and private completion signals. Within noise: submit CPU 20.2/20.7 ms off versus 20.3/20.3 ms on. Keep off.
knobs.summary: Reuses CPU scratch and batches compatible descriptor updates and private completion signals. Within noise: submit CPU 20.2/20.7 ms off versus 20.3/20.3 ms on. Keep off.

knobs.label: Pak material coverage
knobs.description: Uses a locally generated pak mesh table to recover HLOD materials. Requires native material and instanced capture at startup. Unsupported materials keep the existing fallback.
knobs.apply_note: restart to enable; off is live
knobs.summary: Uses a locally generated pak mesh table to recover HLOD materials. Requires native material and instanced capture at startup. Unsupported materials keep the existing fallback.

knobs.label: Experimental lighting reference
knobs.description: Shows a limited reference using point and spot lights on supported opaque surfaces. Two surfaces adds one indirect bounce; incomplete paths retain direct-only lighting and are counted. Requires Hidden-surface shading at startup. No sunlight, sky, emission or full-scene quality claim. This replaces the display for inspection; it is not a gameplay quality preset.
knobs.summary: Shows a limited reference using point and spot lights on supported opaque surfaces. Two surfaces adds one indirect bounce; incomplete paths retain direct-only lighting and are counted. Requires Hidden-surface shading at startup. No sunlight, sky, emission or full-scene quality claim. This replaces the display for inspection; it is not a gameplay quality preset.

knobs.label: Local light sampling (exact-k)
knobs.description: Cost option for interiors with many lights: the strongest 1 or 2 lights of each pixel keep their own shadow ray, and one ray is shared by the rest, picked in proportion to their light and weighted so the mean brightness is unchanged. Needs Local light shadows Full. Off by user decision (developer only).
knobs.apply_note: First use may compile a core pipeline; no game restart.
knobs.summary: Cost option for interiors with many lights: the strongest 1 or 2 lights of each pixel keep their own shadow ray, and one ray is shared by the rest, picked in proportion to their light and weighted so the mean brightness is unchanged. Needs Local light shadows Full. Off by user decision (developer only).

knobs.label: Current cascade sun shadows
knobs.description: Uses the current four native sun-caster domains with finite per-layer rays and native receiver selection. Needs ray-traced geometry, Sun shadows with hidden roofs, RT device setup and the static BVH split. Gives one window of samples, then falls back while the scene is unready (DIALOGUE_SHADOWS.md): developer only until fixed. Restart required.
knobs.summary: Uses the current four native sun-caster domains with finite per-layer rays and native receiver selection. Needs ray-traced geometry, Sun shadows with hidden roofs, RT device setup and the static BVH split. Gives one window of samples, then falls back while the scene is unready (DIALOGUE_SHADOWS.md): developer only until fixed. Restart required.
